description: Source code for repacking promisor objects in a Git repository, including functions to write object IDs, finish repacking, and handle promisor pack geometry.

methods.name: write_oid
methods.description: Writes an object ID to the pack-objects process stdin, starting the process if necessary.

methods.name: finish_repacking_promisor_objects
methods.description: Completes the repacking process for promisor objects, reading object IDs from pack-objects output and creating associated promisor files.

methods.name: repack_promisor_objects
methods.description: Main function to initiate repacking of promisor objects in a repository.

methods.name: pack_geometry_repack_promisors
methods.description: Handles repacking of promisor packs based on geometry, using stdin to pack process.
